7 to 10 tbsp (99 g to 142 g) ice water
904 g peeled, sliced apple, about 0.5 cm thick (from about whole apples)
2 tbsp (28 g) lemon juice
149 g granulated sugar
2 tbsp (14 g) King Arthur Unbleached All-Purpose Flour
2 tbsp (14 g) cornstarch or 2 tbsp (22 g) Instant Clearjel
1/2 tsp (3 g) table salt
1 tsp (5 ml) ground cinnamon*
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ground nutmeg*
1/4 tsp (1.2 ml) ground allspice*
85 g boiled cider or 80 g apple juice concentrate, optional
2 tsp (10 ml) King Arthur Pure Vanilla Extract, optional
2 tbsp (28 g) butter, diced in small pieces
milk or 1 large egg white beaten with 1 tbsp (15 ml) water (egg wash), for brushing
coarse sparkling sugar, for sprinkling
1. To make the crust: In a medium bowl, whisk together the flour and salt.
2. Work in the shortening until the mixture is evenly crumbly. Dice the butter into 1.5 cm pieces, and cut into the mixture until you have flakes of butter the size of a dime.

3. Add the water 2 tbsp (30 ml) at a time, mixing with a fork as you sprinkle the water into the dough. When the dough is moist enough to hold together when you squeeze it, transfer it to a piece of wax or parchment paper. It's OK if there are some dry spots in the pile. Use a spray bottle of water to lightly spritz these places; that way you'll add just enough water to bring the dough together without creating a wet spot.
4. Fold the dough over on itself three or four times to bring it together, then divide it in half. Pat each piece of dough into a disk about 2 cm thick.

5. Roll each disk on its edge, like a wheel, to smooth out the edges. This step will ensure your dough will roll out evenly, without a lot of cracks and splits at the edges later. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for 30 minutes before rolling.
6. Preheat the oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C).
7. Lightly grease a 23 cm pie pan that's at least 4 cm to 5 cm deep; if you use the shallower option, the pie will be more domed.
8. To make the filling: Combine the sliced apples and lemon juice in a large mixing bowl.

9. In a small bowl, whisk together the sugar, flour, cornstarch, salt, and spices. Sprinkle the mixture over the apples, and stir to coat them. Stir in the boiled cider (or apple juice concentrate) and the vanilla.
10. To assemble the pie: Roll one piece of pastry to a 30 cm round. Transfer it to the prepared pan, and trim the edges so they overlap the rim of the pan by 2.5 cm all the way around.
11. Spoon the apple filling into the pan. Dot the top with the diced butter.

12. Roll out the remaining pastry to a 30 cm round. Carefully place the pastry over the apples. Bring the overhanging bottom crust up and over the top crust, pinching to seal the two and making a decorative crimp. Prick the crust all over with a fork, to allow steam to escape. Or cut decorative vent holes, if desired. Alternatively, you can weave a lattice.
13. Place the pie in the refrigerator for 10 minutes to allow the crust to firm up while the oven finishes heating.
14. Place the pie on a parchment-lined baking sheet. To finish the pie, brush the top crust with milk or the egg wash and sprinkle with coarse sparkling sugar for extra crunch and shine.

15. Bake the pie for 20 minutes, then reduce the oven temperature to 190 °C (fan 170 °C) and bake for 40 minutes more, until you see the filling bubbling inside the pie (and perhaps dripping onto the parchment). Check the pie after half an hour of baking time, and cover the edges with foil or a pie shield to keep them from browning too quickly, if necessary.
16. When the pie is done — you should see the filling bubbling vigorously, either around the edges, or via any decorative vents — remove it from the oven.

17. Cool the pie completely before slicing — really. Cutting any fruit pie that's still warm is a messy business. The filling continues to thicken as the pie cools, and if you cut it too soon it will run out all over the place. It's better to bake the pie in advance, cool it completely, then warm each slice as needed after it's been cut.
18. Store any leftover pie, lightly covered, at room temperature for several days. Freeze for longer storage.

1. Cesto: v strednej mise metličkou zmiešame múku a soľ.
2. Zapracujeme stužený tuk, kým nie je zmes rovnomerne drobivá. Maslo nakrájame na kocky 1,5 cm a zapracujeme ho do zmesi, kým nezostanú vločky masla veľké asi ako minca.

3. Vodu pridávame po 2 PL (30 ml) a za kvapkania do cesta miešame vidličkou. Keď je cesto dosť vlhké na to, aby po stlačení držalo pokope, preložíme ho na kus voskového papiera alebo papiera na pečenie. Nevadí, ak v kope zostanú suché miesta. Tie zľahka postriekame vodou z rozprašovača; pridáme tak práve toľko vody, aby sa cesto spojilo, a nevznikne mokré miesto.
4. Cesto trikrát až štyrikrát preložíme, aby sa spojilo, a rozdelíme ho na polovice. Každú polovicu roztlačíme na placku hrubú asi 2 cm.

5. Každú placku pogúľame po hrane ako koleso, aby sa okraje uhladili. Vďaka tomu sa cesto bude vaľkať rovnomerne a okraje nebudú praskať. Zabalíme do fólie a pred vaľkaním necháme 30 minút v chladničke.
6. Rúru predhrejeme na 220 °C (teplovzdušnú na 200 °C).
7. Zľahka vymastíme koláčovú formu s priemerom 23 cm a hĺbkou aspoň 4 až 5 cm; v plytšej forme bude koláč viac klenutý. (Pečenie v keramickej forme pozri v poznámkach.)
8. Plnka: vo veľkej mise zmiešame nakrájané jablká s citrónovou šťavou.

9. V malej miske metličkou zmiešame cukor, múku, kukuričný škrob, soľ a koreniny. Zmesou posypeme jablká a premiešame, aby sa obalili. Vmiešame zahustený jablkový mušt (alebo koncentrát jablkovej šťavy) a vanilku.
10. Skladanie koláča: jednu časť cesta vyvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 30 cm. Preložíme ho do pripravenej formy a okraje zastrihneme tak, aby dookola presahovali okraj formy o 2,5 cm.
11. Do formy nalejeme lyžicou jablkovú plnku. Povrch posypeme kockami masla.

12. Zvyšné cesto vyvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 30 cm. Opatrne ho položíme na jablká. Presahujúci spodný plát preložíme cez vrchný, stlačíme, aby sa spojili, a okraj ozdobne zvlníme. Vrchný plát popicháme vidličkou, aby mohla unikať para, alebo podľa chuti vyrežeme ozdobné otvory. Prípadne môžeme upliesť mriežku.
13. Koláč dáme na 10 minút do chladničky, aby cesto stuhlo, kým sa rúra dohreje.
14. Koláč postavíme na plech vystlaný papierom na pečenie. Vrchný plát potrieme mliekom alebo rozšľahaným vajcom a posypeme hrubým perlovým cukrom, aby bol chrumkavejší a lesklejší.

15. Koláč pečieme 20 minút, potom teplotu znížime na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C) a pečieme ešte 40 minút, kým plnka v koláči nebublá (prípadne nekvapká na papier). Po pol hodine pečenia koláč skontrolujeme a podľa potreby prikryjeme okraje alobalom alebo chráničom okrajov, aby príliš rýchlo nezhnedli.
16. Keď je koláč hotový (plnka musí výrazne bublať pri okrajoch alebo v ozdobných otvoroch), vyberieme ho z rúry.

17. Pred krájaním necháme koláč úplne vychladnúť, naozaj. Krájať ešte teplý ovocný koláč je nepríjemná práca. Plnka pri chladnutí ďalej hustne, a ak koláč nakrojíme priskoro, vytečie. Lepšie je upiecť koláč vopred, nechať ho úplne vychladnúť a jednotlivé kúsky po nakrájaní podľa potreby zohriať.
18. Zvyšok koláča uchováme zľahka prikrytý pri izbovej teplote niekoľko dní. Na dlhšie ho zmrazíme.

en.t: 1. Cut vanilla bean in half lengthwise. Using tip of paring knife, scrape out vanilla seeds and transfer seeds into a medium bowl. Add sugar and rub seeds into sugar to break up clumps, then mix in salt; set aside.

2. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat to 150 °C (fan 130 °C). In a medium saucepan, combine heavy cream, milk, and vanilla bean pod. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat. Remove from heat, cover to prevent evaporation, and steep for 1 hour.

3. Once cream mixture has steeped for 1 hour, bring cream mixture back to a simmer over medium heat. Meanwhile, in a large bowl set on top of a dampened kitchen towel to prevent slipping, whisk eggs, egg yolks, and reserved sugar–vanilla bean mixture until pale yellow, smooth, and fluffy. Pour about 1/4 of the simmering cream mixture into egg mixture, whisking constantly, until smooth and combined. Whisk egg mixture into milk mixture in saucepan, add nutmeg, and whisk to combine.

4. Using a fine-mesh sieve, strain custard into prepared pie crust; discard solids. Bake until just set, center slightly jiggles, and an instant-read thermometer inserted into pie registers 80 °C, 50 to 55 minutes. Cover edges of crust with aluminum foil to prevent overbrowning if needed. Carefully transfer to a wire rack and cool to room temperature, about 2 hours, then cover loosely and chill in refrigerator for at least 3 hours. Serve.

sk.t: 1. Vanilkový struk pozdĺžne rozrežeme. Špičkou malého noža vyškrabeme semienka a dáme ich do strednej misy. Pridáme cukor, semienka do neho vtrieme, aby sa rozdrobili zhluky, a vmiešame soľ; odložíme.

2. Rošt v rúre posunieme do strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 150 °C (teplovzdušnú na 130 °C). V strednom kastróliku spojíme smotanu na šľahanie, mlieko a vyškrabaný vanilkový struk. Na strednom ohni privedieme k miernemu varu. Odstavíme z ohňa, prikryjeme, aby sa tekutina neodparovala, a necháme 1 hodinu lúhovať.

3. Po 1 hodine lúhovania smotanovú zmes znova privedieme na strednom ohni k miernemu varu. Medzitým vo veľkej mise postavenej na navlhčenej utierke (aby sa nešmýkala) vyšľaháme vajcia, žĺtky a odložený vanilkový cukor, kým nie je zmes svetložltá, hladká a nadýchaná. Za stáleho šľahania do vaječnej zmesi vlejeme asi štvrtinu horúcej smotanovej zmesi a šľaháme dohladka. Vaječnú zmes vmiešame metličkou do mliečnej zmesi v kastróliku, pridáme muškátový oriešok a premiešame.

4. Krém precedíme cez jemné sitko do pripraveného koláčového korpusu; zvyšky v sitku vyhodíme. Pečieme, kým krém práve nestuhne, stred sa ešte mierne chveje a vpichový teplomer zapichnutý do koláča neukáže 80 °C, 50 až 55 minút. Ak treba, okraje cesta prikryjeme alobalom, aby príliš nezhnedli. Koláč opatrne preložíme na mriežku a necháme vychladnúť na izbovú teplotu, asi 2 hodiny, potom ho voľne prikryjeme a necháme v chladničke aspoň 3 hodiny. Podávame.

Na strednom ohni privedieme k miernemu varu. Odstavíme z ohňa, prikryjeme, aby sa tekutina neodparovala, a necháme 1 hodinu lúhovať.

3. Po 1 hodine lúhovania smotanovú zmes znova privedieme na strednom ohni k miernemu varu. Medzitým vo veľkej mise postavenej na navlhčenej utierke (aby sa nešmýkala) vyšľaháme vajcia, žĺtky a odložený vanilkový cukor, kým nie je zmes svetložltá, hladká a nadýchaná. en.t: 175 g all-purpose flour, divided, for the pie dough

1/2 tsp (1.5 g) kosher salt; for table salt use half as much by volume

Pinch kosher salt
Pinch cream of tartar
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) vanilla extract

1. Make the pie dough: Combine two-thirds of the flour with the sugar and salt in a food processor and pulse twice. Spread the butter slices evenly over the surface and pulse until no dry flour remains and the dough just begins to collect in clumps, about 25 short pulses. Spread the dough evenly around the bowl with a rubber spatula, sprinkle with the remaining flour, and pulse until the dough is just barely broken up, about 5 short pulses. Transfer to a large bowl.

2. Sprinkle the dough with the water, then fold and press it with a rubber spatula until it comes together into a ball. Form into a 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before rolling.

3. On a well-floured surface, roll the dough into a circle that overhangs a 23 cm pie plate by 2.5 to 5 cm. Roll it around the rolling pin, unroll it over the plate, and fit it into the corners. Trim to a 1.5 cm overhang, tuck the edge under itself, and flute it. Refrigerate the shell until well chilled.

4. For the Crust: Adjust oven racks to upper middle position (about 20 cm from broiler) and lowest position and preheat the oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). Lightly prick chilled pie shell all over bottom in 1.5 cm intervals. Line pie shell with a double layer of 36 cm square of parchment paper or aluminum foil, covering edges to prevent burning. Fill with sugar, pie weights, or dried beans.

5. Transfer to a parchment or foil-lined rimmed baking sheet and bake on lowest rack for 15 minutes. Reduce oven temperature to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Carefully remove liner and pie weights from par baked crust and bake the now uncovered crust until golden brown, about 5 minutes. Set aside and let cool.

6. For the Lemon Filling: In a medium saucepan, combine the water, lemon juice, and zest. In a medium bowl, whisk 295 ml sugar, cornstarch, and salt until combined then add to the saucepan. In a separate bowl, whisk the egg yolks until combined and add to the saucepan. Cook over medium heat, whisking continuously, until the mixture thickens and bubbles, 7 to 8 minutes.

7. Whisk continuously for an additional two minutes once bubbling, then remove from heat. Whisk in butter until fully combined and melted. Strain the curd through a fine-mesh strainer directly into the baked and cooled pie shell and scrape filling off the underside of the strainer into the pie shell. Press plastic wrap directly onto the surface of the filling. Let cool at room temperature for 30 minutes, then refrigerate until well chilled, at least 2 hours or up to 24 hours.
8. For the Meringue: Fill a medium saucepan one quarter full with water. Set the saucepan over medium heat, and bring water to a simmer.

9. In a stand mixer bowl, combine egg whites, 120 ml sugar, salt, and cream of tartar and place over the saucepan with simmering water. Heat, whisking constantly, until sugar is dissolved and egg whites are warm to the touch, 2 to 3 minutes. Test by rubbing between your fingers. Transfer mixer bowl to stand mixer fitted with whisk attachment. Starting on low speed, whip heated egg whites, gradually increasing speed to high, until stiff and glossy peaks form, 8 to 10 minutes. Add vanilla, and mix until combined.

10. For Assembling the Pie: Remove the plastic from the top of the chilled filling. Spoon the meringue evenly around the edge and then center of pie, attaching the meringue to the pie crust (to prevent shrinking while under the broiler). Using back of spoon, create attractive swirls and peaks in meringue.

11. Adjust oven to broiler setting. Broil the pie on the upper-middle rack set about 20 cm from the broiler element until the tips of the meringue are toasted and browned, about 2 minutes Let cool for 10 minutes. Slice and serve.

1. Pripravíme cesto: v kuchynskom robote zmiešame dve tretiny múky s cukrom a soľou a dvakrát pulzne premiešame. Plátky masla rovnomerne rozložíme po povrchu a pulzujeme, kým nezostane žiadna suchá múka a cesto sa práve nezačne zhlukovať do hrudiek, asi 25 krátkych pulzov. Cesto gumenou stierkou rovnomerne rozprestrieme po nádobe, posypeme zvyšnou múkou a pulzujeme, kým sa cesto len sotva nerozdrobí, asi 5 krátkych pulzov. Preložíme do veľkej misy.

2. Cesto pokvapkáme vodou a gumenou stierkou ho prekladáme a pritláčame, kým sa nespojí do gule. Vytvarujeme disk s priemerom 10 cm, pevne zabalíme do fólie a pred vaľkaním necháme aspoň 2 hodiny v chladničke.

3. Na dobre pomúčenej ploche cesto rozvaľkáme na kruh, ktorý presahuje koláčovú formu s priemerom 23 cm o 2,5 až 5 cm. Navinieme ho na valček, rozvinieme nad formou a vtlačíme do rohov. Zastrihneme tak, aby presahovalo o 1,5 cm, okraj podvihneme a zastrčíme pod seba a ozdobne zvlníme. Korpus necháme v chladničke dobre vychladiť.

4. Korpus: rošty v rúre posunieme do hornej strednej polohy (asi 20 cm od grilu) a do najnižšej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 220 °C (teplovzdušnú na 200 °C). Dno vychladeného cestového korpusu zľahka popicháme vidličkou v rozostupoch 1,5 cm. Korpus vystelieme dvojitou vrstvou štvorca papiera na pečenie alebo alobalu (36 × 36 cm) tak, aby boli prikryté aj okraje a nepripálili sa. Naplníme cukrom, keramickými guličkami na pečenie alebo sušenou fazuľou.

5. Preložíme na plech s okrajom vystlaný papierom na pečenie alebo alobalom a pečieme na najnižšom rošte 15 minút. Teplotu znížime na 190 °C (teplovzdušnú na 170 °C). Z čiastočne upečeného korpusu opatrne vyberieme papier so záťažou a odkrytý korpus pečieme dozlatista, asi 5 minút. Odložíme a necháme vychladnúť.

6. Citrónová plnka: v strednom kastróliku spojíme vodu, citrónovú šťavu a kôru. V strednej mise metličkou zmiešame 225 g cukru, kukuričný škrob a soľ a pridáme do kastróla. V inej miske rozšľaháme žĺtky a pridáme ich do kastróla. Za stáleho šľahania varíme na strednom ohni, kým zmes nezhustne a nezačne bublať, 7 až 8 minút.

en.t: 175 g all-purpose flour, divided, for the pie dough
1 tbsp (13 g) sugar, for the pie dough
1/2 tsp (2.5 g) kosher salt, for the pie dough
140 g unsalted butter, cut into 0.5 cm pats, for the pie dough
3 tbsp (43 ml) cold water, for the pie dough
3 eggs (≈150 g without shell), beaten
2 tbsp (30 ml) honey
330 g light corn syrup
53 g brown sugar
4 tbsp (56 g) melted butter, cooled
1/2 tsp (3 g) salt
1 tsp (5 ml) vanilla
340 g toasted pecans (225 g roughly chopped and 115 g left whole)

1. Make the pie dough: Combine two-thirds of the flour with the sugar and salt in a food processor and pulse twice. Spread the butter slices evenly over the surface and pulse until no dry flour remains and the dough just begins to collect in clumps, about 25 short pulses. Spread the dough evenly around the bowl with a rubber spatula, sprinkle with the remaining flour, and pulse until the dough is just barely broken up, about 5 short pulses. Transfer to a large bowl.

2. Sprinkle the dough with the water, then fold and press it with a rubber spatula until it comes together into a ball. Form into a 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before rolling.

3. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and preheat oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Roll pie dough into a circle roughly 30 cm in diameter. Transfer to a 23 cm pie plate. Using a pair of kitchen shears, trim the edges of the pie dough until it overhangs the edge of the pie plate by 1.3 cm all the way around. Fold edges of pie dough down, tucking it under itself, working your way all the way around the pie plate until everything is well tucked. Use the forefinger on your left hand and the thumb and forefinger on your right hand to crimp the edges. If a well-done crust is desired, you may chill and blind bake it before proceeding.
4. In a large bowl, whisk together eggs, honey, corn syrup, brown sugar, melted butter, salt, and vanilla. Whisk for approximately 30 seconds, until the mixture is homogenous and slightly frothy.

5. Line pie crust with chopped pecans, reserving the whole ones. Press down slightly so chopped pecans embed in the dough. Pour the filling mixture over the pecans, then gently place the whole pecans in concentric circles on the top, taking care not to press too hard, which will cause the nuts to sink into the filling.

6. Bake pie for 40 minutes, rotating halfway through baking. Continue baking, shielding the exposed nuts with aluminum foil if they threaten to burn (see instructions for fashioning a foil shield above). When finished, the filling should be slightly jiggly, but mostly set and puffed slightly, about 1 hour total. The filling should register between 79 and 82 °C on an instant-read thermometer. Allow the pie to cool at room temperature for at least 2 hours and up to overnight before serving.

en.t: 10 whole graham crackers

1. Preheat oven to 190 °C (fan 170 °C). Place the graham crackers, sugar, and salt in the bowl of a food processor. Process for approximately 20 to 30 seconds, until the grahams are uniform, small crumbs. Add the melted butter and pulse until incorporated, about 5 pulses. Firmly press the mixture into the bottom and sides of the springform pan (the sides of the crust should only be about 2.5 cm tall). Chill the crust in the fridge for 15 minutes, then bake in preheated oven until set and lightly browned on the edges, 8 to 10 minutes. Transfer pan to a wire rack; let crust cool completely, about 30 minutes. Reduce the oven temperature to 160 °C (fan 140 °C).

2. In the bowl of the food processor, combine the sweetened condensed milk, egg yolks, Key lime juice, and zest. Process for 10 seconds, then stop, scrape down the sides, and process again until smooth and creamy, about another 10 seconds. Using a silicone spatula, scrape the mixture into the bottom of the cooled crust. Bake at 160 °C (fan 140 °C) for 13 to 16 minutes, until it is firm but still jiggles in the center (watch it closely, this pie will set up very quickly). Transfer to a wire rack to cool slightly, about 30 minutes, then place the pie in the fridge to chill for at least four hours.

3. When ready to serve, release and remove the sides of the springform pan and transfer pie to a serving plate. In a large bowl, whisk together mascarpone and powdered sugar until smooth and creamy. Gradually add the cream and whisk until mixture holds soft peaks, 1 to 2 minutes. Pipe or top the pie with the cream mixture and garnish with Key lime zest. Serve immediately.

1. Pripravíme cesto: v kuchynskom robote zmiešame dve tretiny múky s cukrom a soľou a dvakrát pulzne premiešame. Cesto gumenou stierkou rovnomerne rozprestrieme po nádobe, posypeme zvyšnou múkou a pulzujeme, kým sa cesto len sotva nerozdrobí, asi 5 krátkych pulzov. Preložíme do veľkej misy.

2. Cesto pokvapkáme vodou a gumenou stierkou ho prekladáme a pritláčame, kým sa nespojí do gule. Vytvarujeme disk s priemerom 10 cm, pevne zabalíme do fólie a pred vaľkaním necháme aspoň 2 hodiny v chladničke.

1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 175 °C (fan 155 °C). Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat. In a large bowl, set up an ice bath by filling it halfway with cold water and ice. Set aside.

2. For the Filling: Using a sharp paring knife, score small X at base of each peach; set aside. Using a slotted spoon or spider, lower peaches into boiling water and cook until the scored skin at the base of each peach begins to loosen and peel back, about 1 minute. (Firmer peaches may need up to 3 minutes.) Using a slotted spoon or spider, transfer peaches to the ice bath and let stand until cool enough to handle, about 5 minutes.

3. Working with 1 peach at a time, start at scored X on the base of peach and use a paring knife to peel back and remove loosened skin from peach. Discard the skins and repeat with remaining peaches. Cut each peach in half through stem end and remove pit. Slice the peeled peach halves into 1.5 cm thick wedges.
4. In a large bowl, whisk together the light brown sugar, tapioca starch, salt, and vanilla paste. Stir in peach slices and toss to coat. Let stand for 30 minutes.

5. For the Topping: In a food processor, pulse whole-wheat flour, light brown sugar, and salt until well-combined. Add oats and toasted pecans and pulse until pecans just start to break apart, 2 to 3 pulses. Add butter and pulse until mixture resembles a coarse meal with some pea-sized pieces.

6. To Bake: Scrape the macerated peaches and their juices into a 23 × 23 cm square baking dish and press into an even layer. Sprinkle topping evenly over the filling. Bake until the topping is golden brown and juices are bubbling, about 1 hour and 15 minutes. Let cool on wire rack for 30 minutes. Serve.

1. Rošt v rúre posunieme do strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). Vo veľkom hrnci privedieme na silnom ohni do varu vodu. Vo veľkej mise pripravíme ľadový kúpeľ: do polovice ju naplníme studenou vodou a ľadom. Odložíme.

2. Plnka: ostrým malým nožom narežeme na spodku každej broskyne malý krížik; odložíme. Dierovanou alebo cedidlovou naberačkou spustíme broskyne do vriacej vody a varíme, kým sa narezaná šupka na spodku nezačne uvoľňovať a odstávať, asi 1 minútu. 1. For the Strawberry Filling: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). Grease a 20 × 20 cm baking dish and set aside. In a large bowl, stir together strawberries, sugar, lemon zest and juice, and kosher salt to combine. Let sit at room temperature, stirring occasionally, until strawberries release juices and become syrupy, about 30 minutes. Stir in cornstarch until well combined and no dry spots remain. Transfer to prepared baking dish.

2. For the Biscuit Topping: In a separate large bowl, whisk together flour, granulated sugar, baking powder, and salt. Add butter and shortening. Using your hands, pinch butter and shortening firmly to flatten and break up pieces until mixture resembles coarse crumbs no larger than pea-size. Using a spatula, stir buttermilk into flour mixture until a shaggy dough forms. Using a 2-tbsp scoop, drop dough into 9 heaping portions over the filling. Sprinkle dough with turbinado sugar.

3. Bake until biscuits are golden brown and fruit is bubbling, about 45 minutes. If biscuits are well browned before the filling finishes, loosely tent with aluminum foil for the last 15 minutes of baking, if needed. Transfer to a wire rack and let cool for 1 hour. 1. **FOR THE PIE DOUGH:**

2. Combine ice water and sour cream in bowl. Process flour, sugar, and salt in food processor until combined, about 3 seconds. Add butter and pulse until size of large peas, 6 to 8 pulses. Add sour cream mixture and pulse until dough forms large clumps and no dry flour remains, 3 to 6 pulses, scraping down sides of bowl as needed.

3. Form dough into 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 1 hour. (Wrapped dough can be refrigerated for up to 2 days or frozen for up to 1 month. If frozen, let dough thaw completely on counter before rolling.)

4. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). Let chilled dough sit on counter to soften slightly, about 5 minutes, before rolling. Roll dough into 25 cm circle on lightly floured counter. Using pizza cutter, cut dough into four 6.5 cm-wide strips, then make four 6.5 cm-wide perpendicular cuts to form squares. (Pieces around edges of dough will be smaller.) Transfer dough pieces to parchment paper–lined baking sheet, cover with plastic, and refrigerate until firm, at least 30 minutes.
5. **FOR THE FILLING:**

6. Toss apples, sugar, cinnamon, and salt together in large bowl. Melt butter in 25 cm skillet over medium heat. Add apple mixture, cover, and cook until apples become slightly pliable and release their juice, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

7. Whisk cider, cornstarch, and lemon juice in bowl until no lumps remain; add to skillet. Bring to simmer and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, about 2 minutes. Off heat, press lightly on apples to form even layer.
8. **FOR THE TOPPING:**

9. Combine sugar and cinnamon in small bowl. Working quickly, shingle dough pieces over filling until mostly covered, overlapping as needed. Brush dough pieces with egg and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.

10. Bake until crust is slightly puffed and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes. Remove skillet from oven. Using back of large spoon, press down in center of crust until juices come up over top of crust. Repeat four more times around skillet. Make sure all apples are submerged and return skillet to oven. Continue to bake until crust is golden brown, about 15 minutes longer.
11. Transfer skillet to wire rack and let cool for at least 20 minutes. Serve with ice cream, drizzling extra sauce over top.

c.t: 1. **FOR THE PIE DOUGH:**

2. Combine ice water and sour cream in bowl. Process flour, sugar, and salt in food processor until combined, about 3 seconds. Add butter and pulse until size of large peas, 6 to 8 pulses. Add sour cream mixture and pulse until dough forms large clumps and no dry flour remains, 3 to 6 pulses, scraping down sides of bowl as needed.

3. Form dough into 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic wrap, and refrigerate for 1 hour. (Wrapped dough can be refrigerated for up to 2 days or frozen for up to 1 month. If frozen, let dough thaw completely on counter before rolling.)

4. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 205 °C (fan 185 °C). Let chilled dough sit on counter to soften slightly, about 5 minutes, before rolling. Roll dough into 25 cm circle on lightly floured counter. Using pizza cutter, cut dough into four 6.5 cm-wide strips, then make four 6.5 cm-wide perpendicular cuts to form squares. (Pieces around edges of dough will be smaller.) Transfer dough pieces to parchment paper–lined baking sheet, cover with plastic, and refrigerate until firm, at least 30 minutes.
5. **FOR THE FILLING:**

6. Toss apples, sugar, cinnamon, and salt together in large bowl. Melt butter in 25 cm skillet over medium heat. Add apple mixture, cover, and cook until apples become slightly pliable and release their juice, about 10 minutes, stirring occasionally.

7. Whisk cider, cornstarch, and lemon juice in bowl until no lumps remain; add to skillet. Bring to simmer and cook, uncovered, stirring occasionally, until sauce is thickened, about 2 minutes. Off heat, press lightly on apples to form even layer.
8. **FOR THE TOPPING:**

9. Combine sugar and cinnamon in small bowl. Working quickly, shingle dough pieces over filling until mostly covered, overlapping as needed. Brush dough pieces with egg and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar.

10. Bake until crust is slightly puffed and beginning to brown, about 15 minutes. Remove skillet from oven. Using back of large spoon, press down in center of crust until juices come up over top of crust. Repeat four more times around skillet. Make sure all apples are submerged and return skillet to oven. Continue to bake until crust is golden brown, about 15 minutes longer.
11. Transfer skillet to wire rack and let cool for at least 20 minutes. Serve with ice cream, drizzling extra sauce over top.
1. **NA CESTO:**

2. V miske zmiešame ľadovú vodu a kyslú smotanu. V kuchynskom robote premiešame múku, cukor a soľ, kým sa nespoja, asi 3 sekundy. Pridáme maslo a pulzujeme, kým kúsky nemajú veľkosť väčšieho hrášku, 6- až 8-krát. Pridáme smotanovú zmes a pulzujeme, kým cesto nevytvorí veľké hrudky a nezostane žiadna suchá múka, 3- až 6-krát; podľa potreby zotierame steny nádoby.

3. Z cesta vytvarujeme placku s priemerom 10 cm, pevne ju zabalíme do fólie a necháme 1 hodinu v chladničke. (Zabalené cesto vydrží v chladničke najviac 2 dni alebo v mrazničke najviac 1 mesiac. Zmrazené cesto necháme pred vaľkaním úplne rozmraziť na pracovnej doske.)

4. Rošt v rúre posunieme do strednej polohy a rúru zohrejeme na 205 °C (teplovzdušnú na 185 °C). Vychladené cesto necháme pred vaľkaním asi 5 minút na doske trochu zmäknúť. Na zľahka pomúčenej doske ho vyvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 25 cm. Kolieskom na pizzu ho rozrežeme na štyri pásy široké 6,5 cm a potom kolmo na ne urobíme štyri rezy v rozostupoch 6,5 cm, aby vznikli štvorce. (Kúsky pri okrajoch budú menšie.) Kúsky cesta preložíme na plech vystlaný papierom na pečenie, prikryjeme fóliou a necháme v chladničke, kým nestuhnú, aspoň 30 minút.
5. **NA PLNKU:**

6. Vo veľkej mise premiešame jablká, cukor, škoricu a soľ. V panvici s priemerom 25 cm rozpustíme na strednom ohni maslo. Pridáme jablkovú zmes, prikryjeme a za občasného miešania dusíme, kým jablká trochu nezmäknú a nepustia šťavu, asi 10 minút.

7. V miske metličkou vymiešame jablkový mušt, kukuričný škrob a citrónovú šťavu, kým nezostanú hrudky; pridáme do panvice. Privedieme k miernemu varu a bez pokrievky za občasného miešania varíme, kým omáčka nezhustne, asi 2 minúty. Mimo ohňa jablká zľahka pritlačíme do rovnomernej vrstvy.
8. **NA POVRCH:**

9. V malej miske zmiešame cukor so škoricou. Rýchlo poukladáme kúsky cesta so zákrytom na plnku, kým ju takmer celú nezakryjú; podľa potreby sa prekrývajú. Cesto potrieme vajcom a posypeme škoricovým cukrom.

10. Pečieme, kým cesto mierne nenabehne a nezačne hnednúť, asi 15 minút. Panvicu vyberieme z rúry. Zadnou stranou veľkej lyžice zatlačíme do stredu cesta, kým šťava nevystúpi nad cesto. Zopakujeme ešte štyrikrát po obvode panvice. Skontrolujeme, či sú všetky jablká ponorené, a panvicu vrátime do rúry. Pečieme ďalej, kým cesto nie je zlatohnedé, ešte asi 15 minút.
11. Panvicu preložíme na mriežku a necháme aspoň 20 minút chladnúť. Podávame so zmrzlinou a pokvapkáme ďalšou omáčkou.

en.t: 175 g all-purpose flour, divided, for the pie dough
1 tbsp (13 g) sugar, for the pie dough
1/2 tsp (2.5 g) kosher salt, for the pie dough
140 g unsalted butter, cut into 0.5 cm pats, for the pie dough
3 tbsp (43 ml) cold water, for the pie dough
170 g granulated sugar
1/2 tsp (1.5 g) kosher salt
1 tsp (5 ml) ground cinnamon
1 tsp (5 ml) ground ginger
1/2 tsp (2.5 ml) freshly grated nutmeg
225 g cream cheese, at room temperature
1 (425 g) can pumpkin puree, or 425 g homemade pumpkin puree
4 tbsp (56 g) unsalted butter, melted and cooled
3 large eggs (≈150 g without shell)

1. Make the pie dough: Combine two-thirds of the flour with the sugar and salt in a food processor and pulse twice. Spread the butter slices evenly over the surface and pulse until no dry flour remains and the dough just begins to collect in clumps, about 25 short pulses. Spread the dough evenly around the bowl with a rubber spatula, sprinkle with the remaining flour, and pulse until the dough is just barely broken up, about 5 short pulses. Transfer to a large bowl.

2. Sprinkle the dough with the water, then fold and press it with a rubber spatula until it comes together into a ball. Form into a 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before rolling.
3. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position. Place a heavy duty rimmed baking sheet on the rack and preheat oven to 105 °C (fan 85 °C).

4. Roll pie dough into a circle roughly 30 cm in diameter. Transfer to a 23 cm pie plate. Using a pair of kitchen shears, trim the edges of the pie dough until it overhangs the edge of the pie plate by 1.5 cm all the way around. Fold edges of pie dough down, tucking it under itself, working your way all the way around the pie plate until everything is well tucked. Use the forefinger on your left hand and the thumb and forefinger on your right hand to crimp the edges.

5. When oven is ready, line chilled pie shell with foil or parchment paper and fill with weights (you can use reuse dried beans for this), transfer pie to the preheated baking sheet, and bake for 15 minutes. Remove weights and liner, turn pie, and bake until the bottom crust is a golden brown, about 10 minutes. Remove pie shell from oven and allow to cool completely. Reduce heat to 180 °C (fan 160 °C).

6. In the bowl of a food processor, combine sugar, salt, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg, and pulse 3 times to mix. Add the cream cheese and pulse until a homogeneous paste forms. Add the pumpkin and butter and process for 30 seconds. Stop to scrape down the sides of the bowl, then process until the mixture is completely smooth, about 30 seconds longer. Add the eggs and process until completely smooth, scraping down sides as necessary. For extra-smooth pumpkin pie, press the mixture through a fine-mesh strainer or a conical strainer using the back of a ladle.

7. Pour the mixture into prepared pie shell and smooth over the top with a rubber spatula. Rap the shell firmly against the counter a few times in order to release any air bubbles. Transfer pumpkin pie to the baking sheet in the oven and bake until the filling puffs slightly and the center only moves slightly when jiggled, 30 to 35 minutes, rotating the pumpkin pie halfway through baking. Allow the pumpkin pie to cool for at least 1 hour before serving. The pumpkin pie may be chilled for up to 2 days.

1. Pripravíme cesto: v kuchynskom robote zmiešame dve tretiny múky s cukrom a soľou a dvakrát pulzne premiešame. Plátky masla rovnomerne rozložíme po povrchu a pulzujeme, kým nezostane žiadna suchá múka a cesto sa práve nezačne zhlukovať do hrudiek, asi 25 krátkych pulzov. Cesto gumenou stierkou rovnomerne rozprestrieme po nádobe, posypeme zvyšnou múkou a pulzujeme, kým sa cesto len sotva nerozdrobí, asi 5 krátkych pulzov. Preložíme do veľkej misy.

2. Cesto pokvapkáme vodou a gumenou stierkou ho prekladáme a pritláčame, kým sa nespojí do gule. Vytvarujeme disk s priemerom 10 cm, pevne zabalíme do fólie a pred vaľkaním necháme aspoň 2 hodiny v chladničke.
3. Rošt v rúre posunieme do dolnej strednej polohy. Položíme naň pevný plech s okrajom a rúru predhrejeme na 105 °C (teplovzdušnú na 85 °C).

4. Koláčové cesto vyvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom asi 30 cm. Preložíme ho do koláčovej formy s priemerom 23 cm. Kuchynskými nožnicami zastrihneme okraje cesta tak, aby dookola presahovali okraj formy o 1,5 cm. Okraje cesta podvihneme a zastrčíme pod seba po celom obvode formy, kým nie je všetko dobre zastrčené. Ukazovákom ľavej ruky a palcom a ukazovákom pravej ruky okraje ozdobne zvlníme.

5. Teplotu znížime na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C).

1. Make the crust: Whisk the flour, sugar, and salt in a medium bowl. Cut the butter into cubes no smaller than 1.5 cm and toss with the flour mixture to break up the pieces. With your fingertips, smash each cube flat (no rubbing or cutting). Stir in the water, then knead the dough against the sides of the bowl until it comes together in a shaggy ball; it should be between 18 and 21 °C (if not, refrigerate briefly).

2. On a generously floured surface, roll the dough into a rectangle, fold the short sides to the center, close the packet like a book, then fold it in half once more to make a thick block. It should still be between 18 and 21 °C; if not, refrigerate briefly.

3. Roll the dough into a 35 cm circle, transfer it to a 23 cm pie plate, and nestle it into the corners, brushing off excess flour. 1. Pripravíme cesto: v strednej mise metličkou zmiešame múku, cukor a soľ. Maslo nakrájame na kocky nie menšie ako 1,5 cm a premiešame ich s múčnou zmesou, aby sa kúsky oddelili. Každú kocku končekmi prstov roztlačíme naplocho (nemrvíme ani nekrájame). Vmiešame vodu a cesto miesime o steny misy, kým sa nespojí do strapatej gule; má mať 18 až 21 °C (ak nie, nakrátko ho dáme do chladničky).

2. Na bohato pomúčenej ploche cesto rozvaľkáme na obdĺžnik, kratšie strany preložíme do stredu, balíček zavrieme ako knihu a potom ho ešte raz preložíme napoly, aby vznikol hrubý blok. Stále má mať 18 až 21 °C; ak nie, nakrátko ho dáme do chladničky.

3. Cesto rozvaľkáme na kruh s priemerom 35 cm, preložíme do koláčovej formy s priemerom 23 cm a vtlačíme do rohov; prebytočnú múku zmetieme. Okraj zastrihneme tak, aby presahoval o 3 cm, presah preložíme na seba, aby na okraji formy vznikol hrubý lem, a ozdobne ho zvlníme. Zabalíme do fólie a necháme v chladničke aspoň 2 hodiny, najviac cez noc.

4. Rošt v rúre posunieme do dolnej strednej polohy a rúru predhrejeme na 180 °C (teplovzdušnú na 160 °C). Vychladený korpus vystelieme veľkým kusom alobalu pritlačeným do tvaru (ak treba, pridáme druhý), naplníme po okraj cukrom, postavíme na polovičný plech a pečieme, kým korpus úplne nestuhne a po okrajoch nezozlatne, 60 až 75 minút. Alobal zoberieme za okraje a cukor opatrne presypeme do žiaruvzdornej misy, aby vychladol. Ak treba, korpus pečieme ešte niekoľko minút, aby sa dno opieklo.

5. V nerezovom kastróliku (saucier) s objemom 2840 ml spojíme batáty, vyškrabaný vanilkový struk, škoricové tyčinky, celý muškátový oriešok, mlieko, smotanu a cukor. Ak máme váhu, zapíšeme si hmotnosť kastróla so surovinami, aby sme mohli presne odmerať redukciu.

6. Na silnom ohni privedieme do varu, potom oheň stlmíme na stredný až mierny a udržiavame mierny var (pri vyššej teplote by sa mlieko mohlo zraziť). Ohybnou stierkou často zoškrabujeme steny, aby sa na nich neusádzali mliečne bielkoviny, a varíme, kým batáty nie sú úplne rozvarené a mliečna zložka nezhustne na hustú omáčku, asi 55 minút. Kastról má vážiť o 535 g menej ako na začiatku.

Z kastróla vyberieme vanilkový struk a koreniny a ponorným mixérom rozmixujeme batáty s mliečnou zmesou dohladka. (Ak treba, preložíme zmes do menšej nádoby, aby nestriekala.) Metličkou vmiešame mletú škoricu, nastrúhaný muškátový oriešok, soľ a vanilku a potom vajcia. Podľa chuti zmes pred naliatím do pripraveného korpusu precedíme cez jemné sitko.

en.t: 115 g granulated sugar

1. Make the pie dough: Combine two-thirds of the flour with the sugar and salt in a food processor and pulse twice. Spread the butter slices evenly over the surface and pulse until no dry flour remains and the dough just begins to collect in clumps, about 25 short pulses. Spread the dough evenly around the bowl with a rubber spatula, sprinkle with the remaining flour, and pulse until the dough is just barely broken up, about 5 short pulses. Transfer to a large bowl.

2. Sprinkle the dough with the water, then fold and press it with a rubber spatula until it comes together into a ball. Form into a 10 cm disk, wrap tightly in plastic, and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before rolling.
3. On a well-floured surface, roll the dough to 0.5 cm thick, transfer to a parchment-lined sheet, and refrigerate until chilled.

4. Adjust oven rack to lower middle position and preheat oven to 220 °C (fan 200 °C). In a large bowl, whisk together sugar and starch. Add berries and toss to coat with dry mixture. Line a sheet pan with parchment and place the dough sheet on top. Pile strawberry mixture in the center, leaving at least 7.5 cm of dough uncovered on all sides. Fold overhang back up around fruit, encasing it on all sides, folding it into rustic pleats to gather up excess. Chill shaped galette in fridge for 1/2 hour.

5. Remove chilled galette from fridge and brush exposed dough with egg wash and sprinkle with sugar if desired. Place the sheet tray on the prepared rack and bake for 20 minutes, turning halfway through. Lower the temperature to 180 °C (fan 160 °C) and bake for 20-30 additional minutes, until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbling all over. Remove from oven and allow galette to cool completely before serving.

1. For the Filling: Set a wire or steamer rack inside a 5680–7570 ml pot. Set unopened condensed milk can on its side on the rack, then fill pot with room-temperature water, making sure water level is at least 5 cm above can. (The can must remain fully submerged during the entirety of simmering to prevent it from warping and splitting, which can result in the can rupturing and injuries.)

2. Set pot over high heat and bring to a simmer (avoid a vigorous boil). Reduce heat to maintain simmer and cook for 4 hours; check pot every 30 minutes to ensure water level stays above can, adding boiling water as necessary to keep can under 5 cm of water.

1. Plnka: do hrnca s objemom 5,68 až 7570 ml vložíme mriežku alebo vložku na varenie v pare. Neotvorenú plechovku kondenzovaného mlieka položíme na bok na mriežku a hrniec naplníme vodou izbovej teploty tak, aby hladina bola aspoň 5 cm nad plechovkou. (Plechovka musí byť počas celého varenia úplne ponorená, inak sa môže zdeformovať a prasknúť, čo môže viesť k výbuchu plechovky a zraneniu.)

2. Hrniec postavíme na silný oheň a privedieme k miernemu varu (nie prudkému). Oheň stlmíme, aby sa udržal mierny var, a varíme 4 hodiny; každých 30 minút skontrolujeme, či je hladina nad plechovkou, a podľa potreby dolejeme vriacu vodu, aby bola plechovka pod 5 cm vody.

3. Hrniec odstavíme z ohňa a necháme plechovku vychladnúť vo vode na izbovú teplotu, aspoň 1 hodinu. Horúcu plechovku sa nesnažíme otvárať; horúce dulce de leche pod tlakom by mohlo nebezpečne vystreknúť.
4. Keď dulce de leche vychladne, plechovku otvoríme a obsah vylejeme do strednej misy. Metličkou vmiešame ½ ČL (3 g) soli, kým sa dobre nespojí. Odložíme.

5. Korpus: kým sa dulce de leche varí, pripravíme korpus. Rošt v rúre posunieme do stredu a rúru predhrejeme na 175 °C (teplovzdušnú na 155 °C). V nádobe kuchynského robota pulzne rozdrvíme sušienky digestive na piesok. (Prípadne ich dáme do uzatvárateľného vrecka a valčekom rozdrvíme na piesok.) Ohybnou stierkou preložíme drvinu do strednej misy a vmiešame soľ. Na sušienky vylejeme rozpustené maslo a premiešame, aby sa omrvinky rovnomerne obalili. Drvinu vysypeme do koláčovej formy s priemerom 23 cm a rozložíme rovnomerne po dne aj stenách. Prstami a odmerkou s plochým dnom omrvinky pevne pritlačíme, aby vznikla kompaktná rovnomerná vrstva. Pečieme, kým korpus zľahka nezozlatne a nevonia maslom, 25 až 30 minút. Hotový korpus preložíme na mriežku a necháme úplne vychladnúť, asi 30 minút, potom ho opatrne vyberieme z formy. Odložíme až do plnenia.

6. V mise kuchynského robota s metlou šľaháme smotanu na šľahanie na strednej rýchlosti, kým nevytvorí stredne mäkké špičky, asi 6 minút. (Prípadne ju vyšľaháme obľúbeným spôsobom, napríklad metličkou alebo ručným šľahačom.)

7. Plnku z dulce de leche vylejeme do korpusu a navrch poukladáme plátky banánov. Ohybnou alebo zalomenou stierkou koláč rovnomerne pokryjeme šľahačkou. Ak zdobíme strúhanou čokoládou, tabuľku čokolády položíme na tanier vhodný do mikrovlnnej rúry a zohrejeme ju, kým nie je natoľko teplá, že na nej zostane odtlačok prsta, asi 10 sekúnd. Škrabkou na zeleninu v tvare Y strúhame boky tabuľky nad koláčom pohybom hore a dole, aby vznikli malé čokoládové hobliny. Podávame ihneď.
